Fine Young Cannibals were a British pop and soul band formed in 1984 by Roland Gift, Andy Cox, and David Steele, the latter two formerly of The Beat. Known for their distinctive sound and Roland Gift’s striking vocals, they became one of the most recognizable bands of the 1980s, achieving worldwide success with hits like She Drives Me Crazy and Good Thing from their album The Raw & the Cooked.
